title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
grouping: A narrow left column of two light-grey outlined rounded panels explains tokenization ('Task Tokens': words -> green Language Encoder -> green pills; 'Observation Tokens': camera frame cut into a 3x3 patch grid with older frames stacked behind -> blue CNN trapezoid -> blue pills; each adds positional encoding from a circled sine glyph p through circled plus signs, ending in math labels T_T and T_o). The wide right side is two rows split by a thin grey rule, labelled at the left by large grey 'Pre-Training' (up arrow) and 'Finetuning' (down arrow). In each row a sequence of tall rounded column groups - green Task, blue Observation, purple Readout, blue Observation, purple Readout, blue Observation - each named above in its own colour, shows input pills above and output pills below the backbone.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded shapes with thin coloured outlines and pale tints. The backbone is one long white rounded bar with a grey outline, 'Octo Transformer' in large grey type beside an octopus emoji, laid across all column groups so it covers their middles; three faint grey dots at its right end mean the sequence continues. Readout output pills drop by short elbow arrows into purple 'Action Head' boxes ending in an italic a. In the finetuning row every pre-existing column is faded to a ghost; new observation tokens, the new action-space readout and a 'New Action Head' are drawn saturated with dashed outlines, named by callout boxes ('New Observation', 'New Action Space') whose elbow arrows point down into them.
proposed_highlight: No 'ours' colour is needed (it is all the proposed model); the finetuning row emphasises what changes by fading everything else to near-white, leaving only the dashed, saturated new tokens and head, each named by a callout.
lesson: Show finetuning as a copy of the pretraining row with everything unchanged faded to a ghost, so only the new observation tokens, action space and head - dashed and saturated, each with a callout - stand out.
notes: Venue RSS from Semantic Scholar (title match, venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2024 = S2 year and arXiv year. Elements 'icon' = octopus emoji mascot; 'equation' = T_T, T_o, p, a math labels.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: generalist robot policy pretraining and finetuning

core.what: pre-training and finetuning drawn as two stacked rows of the same token sequence crossed by one Octo Transformer bar, the finetuning row greying out unused groups and adding dashed new observation, action-space and head elements

relations.form: two identical rows split by a thin grey rule and labelled 'Pre-Training' (up arrow) and 'Finetuning' (down arrow); the lower row fades unchanged token groups and outlines the new ones in dashed lines
within each row tall tinted column groups run left to right: Task, Observation, Readout, Observation, Readout, Observation, then an ellipsis
one long translucent 'Octo Transformer' bar with the octopus logo crosses every token column in each row
a narrow left column of two rounded panels explains how Task Tokens and Observation Tokens are made, coloured to match the green and blue columns on the right
the observation panel draws a real robot-workspace photo cut by a white 3x3 patch grid, with older frames stacked behind, feeding a CNN trapezoid
in each tokenizer panel a positional signal p runs along a horizontal bus and is added at circled-plus nodes to each token

channels.colour: green = task/language tokens, blue = observation tokens, purple = readout tokens and action heads; fade (low opacity) = untouched in finetuning
channels.shape: rounded pills = tokens, tall tinted columns = token groups, long bar = the transformer, trapezoid = CNN, box = encoder/head
channels.line: solid = existing path, dashed = new elements added in finetuning (new observation, action space, action head)
channels.frame: rounded grey frames hold the two tokenizer panels; the two right-hand rows are unframed

quality.strengths: The finetuning claim is visible as geometry: the same row is repeated below with faded unused groups and dashed new slots, so what is reused and what is added can be read without text; token colours carry one meaning each and are taught once in the tokenizer panels; inputs are real data (quoted words, a patched photo).
quality.weaknesses: The New Observation callout routes with two long elbowed lines to slots far apart; the transformer bar overlaps and hides the middle of every token column, so the input/output token correspondence is implicit; the octopus logo is decoration inside the main block.

insights.structure: A narrow left column of two grey-outlined rounded panels explains tokenization (Task Tokens, Observation Tokens); the wide right side is two rows split by a thin grey rule, 'Pre-Training' above and 'Finetuning' below, each a sequence of tall tinted column groups (Task, Observation, Readout, ...) crossed by one long 'Octo Transformer' bar.
insights.data: Language is quoted words feeding a green Language Encoder, images are a camera photo with a white 3x3 patch grid and older frames stacked behind feeding a blue CNN trapezoid; tokens are rounded pills tinted green (task), blue (observation) and purple (readout), with positional encoding as a circled sine glyph added through circled plus signs.
insights.emphasis: The finetuning row repeats the pretraining row with every unchanged column faded to a ghost, leaving only dashed, saturated new observation tokens, the new action-space readout and a 'New Action Head', each named by a callout box.
insights.flow: Tokenization panels read top to bottom on the left; each right row reads left to right along the token sequence, with readout pills dropping by short elbow arrows into Action Head boxes that output an italic a.
insights.avoid: The transformer bar is drawn on top of the column groups and covers their middles, so the token columns look cut in half rather than passing through the model.

arrangement.units: two stacked unframed rows ('Pre-Training', 'Finetuning') separated by a thin rule and labelled at the left with up/down arrows; plus a left column of two grey-outlined rounded panels for the tokenizers
arrangement.inputs_as: real photo and quoted instruction words inside the left tokenizer panels
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; action outputs 'a' at the right of Action Head boxes below each row
arrangement.shared: the same Octo Transformer bar and token layout repeat in both rows
